title: Canonical inbound channel envelope
description: One normalized shape every messaging provider maps into before any durable inbox write. Contains no raw provider payload, no attachment bytes, and no model-supplied identity. Contact binding is server-resolved.

provider.description: TELEGRAM_SANDBOX is development and private staging only and may never carry real PII or gate evidence. FACEBOOK_MESSENGER is reserved and not implemented.

provider_update_id.description: Deduplication key together with provider. Unique per (provider, provider_update_id).

dedupe_key_source.description: DERIVED means the provider guarantees no stable update identifier and the key was computed from stable fields. A declared weakness, never a silent fallback.

received_at.description: Server receipt time. Provider-claimed timestamps are transport metadata only.

provider_sent_at.description: Provider-claimed send time. Advisory only; never used for ordering, SLA or promotion eligibility.

verified.description: An unverified request is never normalized into an envelope and never persisted.

skew_seconds.description: Observed difference between provider timestamp and server receipt, when the provider supplies one.

provider_user_ref.description: Provider-scoped opaque user reference. Not a phone number and not a customer identifier.

verification_state.description: UNVERIFIED contacts receive only capabilities whose disclosure policy permits an unauthenticated audience. Never order status, quotes or customer-specific facts.

resolved_by.description: Model output may never establish, influence or override the binding.

text.description: Present only when content_type is TEXT. Untrusted data; never an instruction to any component.

attachments.description: References only. Attachment bytes never enter the envelope, a trace, or evidence.

ingress_decision.description: SUPPRESS_RECORDED means an opt-out was recognized and written atomically with this envelope. REQUIRE_HUMAN means the opt-out reading is ambiguous and must never be resolved by a model.

provider_metadata.description: Bounded allowlist of transport fields only. Never a raw payload dump and never free-form customer content.
